description.en: The name of the data catalog.
The region where the data lake resides.

description.zh: 函数名匹配的正则表达式，用于过滤返回的函数名称。
description.en: A regular expression used to filter function names.
The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 如果**NextToken**为空表示没有下一次查询。
- 如果**NextToken**有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌。
description.en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If the response to a previous request is truncated, you can use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

- If **NextToken** is empty, there is no next query.

- If a value is returned for **NextToken**, that value is the token for the next query.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-data-lake-function --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 3000 --catalog-name hive --db-name default --function-name-pattern .0 --next-token f056501ada12c1cc --max-results 20 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
